libmodbus Notice
=================

Name: libmodbus
Version used by this SDK: 3.1.12
Project: https://github.com/stephane/libmodbus
License: LGPL-2.1-or-later

GHand C++ SDK links to libmodbus dynamically for RS485/Modbus RTU support.
The libmodbus headers bundled under deps/include/modbus carry the upstream
SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.1-or-later notices.

When distributing GHand C++ SDK binaries that include libmodbus binaries
(such as modbus.dll or libmodbus.so.5.1.0), provide the corresponding
libmodbus 3.1.12 source code, including any local modifications if present.
Users must not be prevented from replacing the dynamically linked libmodbus
binary with an ABI-compatible modified version.
